🌟 stealth-browser-mcp | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling AI agents to perform complex and stealthy web automation tasks, including bypassing anti-bot measures and interacting with web pages programmatically.
✨ Key Features: • Anti-bot resistance (Cloudflare, Queue-It) • Extensive toolset (101 tools) • Modular loading (core or full) • Pixel-accurate element cloning (CSS, DOM, events, assets) • Network inspection (requests, responses, headers, payloads)
📖 Summary: Stealth Browser MCP is a Python library designed for AI agents to automate browser interactions. It leverages the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and FastMCP to bypass anti-bot measures like Cloudflare challenges, enabling sophisticated web automation tasks.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 Alexandrie | Vue
🎯 Primary Use Case: Self-hosted knowledge management and wiki for individuals and teams.
✨ Key Features: • One-Command Deployment (Docker) • Advanced Markdown Engine (LaTeX, custom containers, diagrams) • Granular Organization (Teams, Workspaces, Categories) • Offline-First PWA • OpenID Connect (OIDC) SSO
📖 Summary: Alexandrie is a self-hosted, open-source knowledge base and wiki platform that serves as an alternative to Notion, Confluence, and Obsidian. It offers advanced Markdown editing, offline-first capabilities via a PWA, team collaboration features, and enterprise-grade security like OIDC/SSO.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 starsift | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide developers and security professionals with a tool to audit the authenticity of GitHub repository stars, thereby enhancing supply chain security and trust in open-source projects.
✨ Key Features: • Detects fake GitHub stars by analyzing account behavior. • Uses GH Archive data and a time-matched control group for comparison.
📖 Summary: Starsift is a Python CLI tool designed to detect fake GitHub stars by analyzing account behavior. It leverages GH Archive data and compares a repository's stargazers against a control group of randomly selected accounts from the same time period to identify potential star farms, especially after GitHub restricted access to the stargazers list.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 parallax | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Building a distributed AI cluster for model inference across heterogeneous and geographically dispersed nodes, enabling efficient local LLM hosting and deployment.
✨ Key Features: • Host local LLM on personal devices • Cross-platform support • Pipeline parallel model sharding • Paged KV cache management & continuous batching for Mac • Dynamic request scheduling and routing for high performance
📖 Summary: Parallax is a decentralized inference engine that allows users to build AI clusters from distributed nodes with varying configurations. It enables hosting local LLMs on personal devices and supports cross-platform deployment with features like pipeline parallel model sharding and dynamic request scheduling for high performance.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 MLX-GRPO | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Fine-tuning Large Language Models on Apple Silicon using the GRPO algorithm within a pure MLX environment.
✨ Key Features: • Pure MLX Integration on Apple Silicon • GRPO Training Pipeline with multiple reward functions • Universal Model Support (Hugging Face conversion) • Dataset Preprocessing (GSM8K) • Modern Python Packaging (pyproject.toml, uv CLI)
📖 Summary: MLX-GRPO is a Python-based training framework for fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) exclusively on Apple Silicon using Apple's MLX framework. It implements Group-based Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for chain-of-thought prompting and supports universal Hugging Face model conversion, dataset preparation, and inference tools.
